title: HealthResponse
description: GET /health. The server is up whenever this answers; llama says whether the model can be used (missing files → S0-1 first run, §12, §13).

state.description: fake: AIPLOT_FAKE_LLM=1 fixtures, no model. missing_binary / missing_model: first run or files removed. starting: process up, model loading. ready: usable. error: stopped after 3 restarts or a start failure; message says why.

restarts.description: Restarts of an unresponsive or crashed llama-server in this session (at most 3).

vram.description: From nvidia-smi; null when it cannot be read.
